neighbours.label: intensifier 'sheer / pure / utter' before an emotion or abstract noun
fire: When the results came in, she shouted in sheer relief.
Our team won the match through sheer determination and grit.
Holding the newborn for the first time was pure bliss.
The speech he gave afterwards was utter nonsense from start to finish.
They stared at the burning building in sheer horror.
Finding the lost ring in the sand was pure luck.
The children squealed with pure delight at the puppies.
After the storm the village was left in utter ruin.
quiet: When the results came in, she shouted in great relief.
Our team won the match through hard work and grit.
Holding the newborn for the first time was real bliss.
The speech he gave afterwards was mostly nonsense from start to finish.
They stared at the burning building in silent horror.
Finding the lost ring in the sand was good luck.
The children squealed with obvious delight at the puppies.
After the storm the village was left in deep ruin.

notes: Card: ' sheer' x15, ' pure' x12, ' utter' x1. Probe: 'pure happiness' 1.1, 'utter chaos' 0.6, literal 'pure water' 0.17. Near misses swap in other intensifiers.
